description: Use this when the user needs the incoming mail (IMAP) server settings for an email provider, such as Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud or Zoho. Returns the host, ports with encryption and the provider's setup guide. Never asks for the user's credentials.

imap_provider_name.description: The email provider name to look up, e.g. gmail, outlook, yahoo
